summary.uncertainty: 同种子内指定座位、阵容和开局等权平均，再按种子估计标准误及95%正态近似区间。共享初始牌墙不保证动作分歧后各家摸牌相同，也不保证降噪；小样本只作诊断，各开局分层单独解释，不自动判定通过。

limitations: 8 already-used development seeds; no new formal holdout
Both external references share one upstream author/implementation family
Sampled values are biased model estimates, not real win probabilities
